title: What the live paper record shows
description: The engines' own state, read from the running record: what is open, what closed, and what the market filter is doing right now.
body:
This record is paper only. No real orders are placed anywhere in it. It is the engines' own state, read from the running record: what is open, what closed, and what the market filter is doing right now. A single trade says nothing about a strategy, and the live snapshot below was read at 2026-11-13T03:02:10.016Z. The point of the page is to report the live record as it stands, in plain language, with no projection.

## What this record is

Every position here is paper. trend-daily-v005 counts its live record from 1 October 2026 and trend-daily-v006 from 9 October 2026. The first live signal was an ATOM entry at 2.066 after the 10 October 2026 daily close. ATOM exited below its 10-day low at the 18 October 2026 close, at 1.703, which is −17.9% after the 30 bps round trip. A NEAR entry at 5.896 on 12 October 2026 has been open since. In testing the average winner was roughly +19%, so a losing start is the expected case rather than a surprise. That expectation is a statement about the tested distribution of trades, not a claim that any specific live trade had to lose. The live starts are part of the framing: engine 005 begins its live record on 1 October 2026 and engine 006 on 9 October 2026, so the record is young and the sample of closed trades is small. The same numbers appear on the performance page, in the signal log, and in the status posted to the channel.

## Open positions on paper

htf-rsi-v007 has 0 positions open on paper. trend-daily-v005 has 0 positions open on paper. trend-daily-v006 has 0 positions open on paper. The NEAR entry at 5.896 on 12 October 2026 has been open since, so it is the one open position in the record described above. With no other open positions, the current state is mostly closed trades plus that one open NEAR position. An open position is not a result; it is an unfinished measurement, and its final net figure is not yet in the closed-trade averages. Paper status means the positions are tracked, not executed; the 0 open counts describe the engine state rather than a trading decision made in a live account.

## Closed trades so far

ATOM is the most recent closed trade described in the record: it exited below its 10-day low at the 18 October 2026 close, at 1.703, for −17.9% after the 30 bps round trip. htf-rsi-v007 has 4 closed trades so far, with average null net per trade. trend-daily-v005 has 6 closed trades so far, with average −13.22% net per trade. trend-daily-v006 has 7 closed trades so far, with average −13.34% net per trade. These averages are the recorded net results after costs as stated, not a forecast of the next trade. A closed trade supplies one completed observation; the average across several closed trades is still a small sample, and the record does not say that the next observation will match it. The ATOM result is a single completed trade, and the trend-engine averages combine 6 and 7 closed trades respectively; none of those counts is large enough to settle whether the tested expectation will hold in this live period.

## Market filter and distance to breakouts

trend-daily-v005 has the Bitcoin market filter off. trend-daily-v006 has the Bitcoin market filter off. With both trend engines showing the filter off, the record also shows 0 positions open on paper for each. The closest names to a 20-day breakout are AVAXUSDT at 7.69% below its high, TRXUSDT at 10.39% below its high, and BNBUSDT at 13.54% below its high for trend-daily-v005; and AVAXUSDT at 7.69% below its high, TRXUSDT at 10.39% below its high, and JUPUSDT at 11.47% below its high for trend-daily-v006. These distances are measurements from the running record, not signals to act on. The filter state and the distance measurements describe the market conditions that the engines are reading; they do not by themselves explain why any individual trade won or lost. The off state of the Bitcoin market filter is reported as the engines' own state at the snapshot time; the record does not add an interpretation beyond that.

## Reading this record

The record updates continuously. The same numbers appear on the performance page, in the signal log, and in the status posted to the channel. This page reports the live record as it stands, in plain language, with no projection. It does not say whether any engine will improve, and it does not turn the closed-trade averages into a promise about future results. Where a measurement is null, as with the average net per trade for htf-rsi-v007, the record reports null rather than filling the gap. Where a trade is still open, as with NEAR, the record leaves it out of the closed-trade averages until it closes. Checking the performance page, the signal log, and the channel status should show the same figures; if they differ, the snapshot time 2026-11-13T03:02:10.016Z is the reference point for this reading.
